entries.text: I came as quickly as I could—like I’d do any less\nfor my best friend in the whole world![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_first_01

entries.text: To be honest, I sorta just came ’cause it was you\nwho called and all, but...man, look at this place!\r\nBlueberry Academy is something else![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_00

entries.text: Their classes are all battle focused, right? It’s like\na whole day full of our old battle studies classes![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_01

entries.text: I’m sure Nemona would love to have gone to\nschool in a place like this, but I’d miss having\r\npractical classes like home ec and stuff...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_02

entries.text: If you had to choose just one subject, which do\nyou think you’d pick? Battle studies or home ec?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_03

entries.text: Battle studies!
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_select_01

entries.text: Home ec!
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_select_02

entries.text: Ah. Yeah, guess that checks out. You’re the\nstrongest little Champ—you even beat Nemona,\r\nafter all...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_04

entries.text: Yes! Knew we were two peas in a little pod, bud!\c\nHome ec has so many good things to teach you!\nTry hard, and you can make the best sandwiches![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_04b

entries.text: Actually, Director Clavell was telling me that if I\ndo some studying while I’m here, I’ll be able to\r\nget some extra credits for our school back home.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_05

entries.text: I’d sorta fallen behind on that front, so I’m gonna\nwork hard and rack up those credits![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_06

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Yo, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Just the person I
was
hoping
to
talk to...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_00

entries.text: See, I’ve noticed that folks here aren’t really\nabout the picnic and sandwich life. Is that stuff\r\nnot a big deal here?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_01

entries.text: You think it isn’t?!
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_01

entries.text: I’m pretty sure it is...
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_02

entries.text: What’s that? You made a super-spicy sandwich\nfor one of the Elite Four?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_02

entries.text: Maybe...maybe I’m wrong, then, about people\nhere not caring about sandwiches![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_03

entries.text: See, the thing is, I was whipping up a snack in\nthat Terarium place earlier, and these Blueberry\r\nkids all gathered round to watch...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_04

entries.text: They were all staring like they’d never seen\nanything like it! It was super embarrassing...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_05

entries.text: I was so flustered I ended up just making ’em all\nsandwiches to eat too...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_06

entries.text: That sounds nice!
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_03

entries.text: You’re sweet, Arven
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_04

entries.text: It wasn’t nice at all! It was a total hassle!\c\nOh... I guess you mean for the kids who got to\neat the sandwiches? Sure, nice for THEM![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_07

entries.text: Wha—! A-am not! I’m completely sour! I just\ncouldn’t stand the pressure of all those eyes![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_07b

entries.text: But if it’s not that unusual to make sandwiches\naround here, then why’d they all stare like that?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_08

entries.text: Man, I don’t know if I’m cut out for this place...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_09

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh! [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! I got an update\nfor you![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_00

entries.text: I solved the mystery of why your bud Arven was\ngetting mobbed by those Blueberry kids![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_01

entries.text: So, apparently, the real reason they were all\nstaring was...a case of mistaken identity![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_02

entries.text: How’d that come about?
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_01

entries.text: Who’d they think you were?
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_02

entries.text: I don’t really know, myself...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_03

entries.text: I guess some guy shows up in the Terarium every\nso often and gives away super-spicy sandwiches?\r\nAnd they all thought I was him?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_04

entries.text: That’s why they were all being so weird, watching\nme with...expectation, or whatever, in their eyes.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_05

entries.text: Who is this mystery fellow that just gives away\nsandwiches from time to time? I hear they even\r\ncall him “the spiciest of souls”![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_06

entries.text: I might have an idea!
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_03

entries.text: Boy, I wonder...
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_04

entries.text: You know him?! I guess there are all sorts of\nweird characters at this school, too![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_07

entries.text: Man, I’ll never solve this mystery! There must be\nsome weird characters at this school![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_07b

entries.text: Speaking of weird characters and all...I’ve got a\nreal character I wanted to show you![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_00

entries.text: See, this Skwovet I’ve got has a pretty unusual\nAbility...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_01

entries.text: So I figured this’d be a good excuse for you and\nme to trade Pokémon! How ’bout it?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_02

entries.text: All right! Then I’ll offer up that Skwovet to you.\nWho’ll you go with, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)]’s a good call! Figures you’d
go
with
a
choice
like
that.\c
I’ll be sure to take real good care of it and make
sure it’s happy, along with Mabosstiff and all![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You good to go forward with trading your
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
for
my
Skwovet?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_00

entries.text: You can’t trade Arven a Pokémon if you aren’t\nits original Trainer!
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_01

entries.text: You can’t trade Arven such a rare Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_02

entries.text: You can’t trade Arven a Shiny Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_03

entries.text: Oh, wait—we can’t trade if you’ve only got one\nPokémon with you. C’mon, bud, you know that!\r\nBring at least two little guys with you next time![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_03_00

entries.text: Oh? No good right now, huh? Well, get yourself\nprepped and come back![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_03_01

entries.text: Yo! You ready for that trade now?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_04_00

entries.text: Mabosstiff’s been beggin’ me for another chance\nto battle you, you know. What do you say, bud?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_talkto_00

entries.text: Yeah, you must be busy, huh... I get that!\c\nDon’t you worry. I’ll make sure Mabosstiff\nunderstands why it’s a no this time.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_cancel_00

entries.text: Yesss! That’s my best bud! I’m so ready for this![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 69]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: Sheesh, you’re a little menace in battle, like\nusual![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: I tried training up my team so that we wouldn’t\nlose to you again, but no dice![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: Oh, and I just remembered—I found these funny\nphone cases at the airport...so I bought ’em![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: I thought of you the moment I saw them!\nSo there—a little present for a great battle![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: You received a set of [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Sandwich Cases [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from\nArven!
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_reward_00

entries.text: We might’ve lost, but I’d say Mabosstiff looks\nreal satisfied![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: Thanks for the battle, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: Whoa, no way! Did I actually luck out and get a\nwin on you?! Well, I’ll be a Mankey’s uncle![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
I sure was shocked to see Toedscool swimming
out in the sea in that Terarium dome!\c
I guess they aren’t really Toedscool, but some
other Pokémon—still, what a resemblance![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

Though the Academy Pizza they serve in the
